page_title: SEV 0-1 CEL | Sevilla v Celta Vigo 12/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

90+2' Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla)'s poor effort is easily saved by Ionut Radu. He connects well with a cross, but mistimes it a little, and it heads towards the middle of the target and straight into the grateful hands of the goalkeeper.
90+1' We are about to witness a substitution. Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) is replacing Oscar Mingueza.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla.

90' Oso (Sevilla) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Sevilla.
89' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
88' 0 - 1 Goal! Odysseas Vlachodimos gets a hand on the penalty from Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
88' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) is going to take the penalty!
86' The referee shows a yellow card to Batista Mendy (Sevilla). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
86' Oso (Sevilla) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Sanchez saw the whole situation. PENALTY to Celta Vigo!
84' Claudio Giraldez isn't happy on the touchline after referee Jose Sanchez shows him a yellow card.
83' Here is a change. Juanlu Sanchez is going off and Matias Almeyda gives the last tactical orders to Miguel Sierra (Sevilla).
82' A substitution has been made. Kike Salas goes off and Tanguy Nianzou (Sevilla) comes on.
81' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

81' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom left corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Odysseas Vlachodimos. What a save! Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.

81' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Odysseas Vlachodimos, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
80' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) commits a rough foul. Jose Sanchez stops the game and makes a call.
79' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) is flagged for offside.
78' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ionut Radu, who smothers the ball.
78' The attendance is 31383.
75' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
75' Jose Sanchez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
73' The goalkeeper denies the long-range shot from Batista Mendy (Sevilla). It wasn't such a big threat for him.

72' A pass travels right across the box to Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Odysseas Vlachodimos denies him with a decent save.
71' The possession of the ball – 59:41.

33' A cross into the box from Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) is cleared.

30' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sevilla comes to nothing.

27' Peque (Sevilla) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.

14' A corner kick by Sevilla is thwarted by the well prepared Ionut Radu (Celta Vigo).
14' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Isaac Romero (Sevilla). The ball is out of play. Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner.

13' Batista Mendy (Sevilla) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Good work from Sevilla as they win a corner.
10' Sevilla have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
10' Peque (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Sevilla win a corner kick.
8' Sevilla are seeing far more of the ball now.
